content: For testing MSA, we used the aforementioned WikiNews dataset. Again, we compared our results to five other systems, namely Farasa BIBREF31, MADAMIRA BIBREF29, RDI (Rashwan et al., 2015), MIT (Belinkow and Glass, 2015), and Microsoft ATKS BIBREF28. For CA testing, we used the 5,000 sentences that we set aside. Again, we compared to our best MSA system.
